description: This file defines a React functional component named EditUserModal that provides a user interface for editing user details through a modal dialog. It includes form fields for user email, user role, spend, budget, and reset budget options, utilizing various UI components and hooks.

methods.name: EditUserModal
methods.description: React functional component that renders a modal with a form for editing user information.

methods.name: handleCancel
methods.description: Handles user cancel action, resets form and invokes onCancel callback.

methods.name: handleEditSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, invoking onSubmit callback with form data, then resets form and calls onCancel.
